$comment: Task 8j: what Kino does with a player action, by who asks (owner: the plugin whose title plays; contributed: a panel another plugin contributes, Task 8k), why (origin) and whether playerControl is granted (control). The app (PlayerControlTest, PlayerControlRules.sift + PanelPlayerGate) and the kit (player-control.test.mjs, panel.mjs siftPlayer + kino-shim.mjs playerControlGate) read these same cases. sift: kept null means nothing reaches the player. gate: each step at atMs through ONE gate (one plugin); live, held (Kino not in front, a Kino dialog, the person seeking), casting (the phone player held for a cast) and paused (the video is paused now) default to false.
